title: Re: Beta feedback from 12 Westbrook students
text:
Hi again Wop,

As promised, here are the notes from the engineering study groups (8 more students):

- They loved the "exam cram" study style. One group used it every night before their calculus midterm.
- Groups of 5 felt too big for problem sets. Most said 3 or 4 is ideal.
- Two students asked if they could see a group's past session times before joining.
- Everyone on iOS said the app felt fast. On older Android phones, the matching screen took a few seconds to load.

So far the library room booking idea is still the number one request across both rounds. I can ask the Westbrook library staff if they have a booking system Pairly could connect to.

Talk soon,
Tomás Rivera
Campus Ambassador, Westbrook University

On Tue, Oct 13, 2026 10:37 PM, Wop testwell <woptestwell@gmail.com> wrote:

> Hi Wop,
>
> I sat down with 12 of our Westbrook beta testers this week. Here's a summary of what they said.
>
> What they liked:
> - Getting matched with people from the same course section, not just the same course
> - The weekly free-time grid. Several people said it was faster than texting a group chat.
> - The reminder 30 minutes before a session (when it works, see below)
>
> What they didn't like:
> - The "about you" screen in onboarding felt too long, and 4 people almost quit there
> - 5 testers on Android 15 never got any notifications
> - There's no way to leave a group without messaging everyone
>
> Biggest request: a way to book a library study room right from the app.
>
> I'll send more notes after I talk to the engineering study groups on Monday.
>
> Tomás Rivera
> Campus Ambassador, Westbrook University
>
